dedupe_keys.name: working conditions dataset for safety inspection in bangladesh garment factories accord and alliance inspections

description: This dataset assembles factory safety inspection results for Bangladeshi ready-made garment factories that supply North American and European retailers. The Dataverse record says it draws on the two legally binding retailer consortia set up to improve factory safety, the Accord on Fire and Building Safety in Bangladesh (European retailers) and the Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety (North American retailers), and holds, for each, the inspection reports taken from the consortium website and counts of safety issues per factory. It was published in March 2018 (version 1) by Xiaojin Liu of the UVA Darden School of Business as four tab-separated files of about 1.2 MB in total, downloadable free under CC0. Coverage is Bangladesh garment factories inspected by the two consortia. Caveats: it is a snapshot taken in March 2018, the column definitions and number of factories are not stated on the page read, and the underlying inspections are the consortia's own. For simulation it gives factory-level fire, electrical and structural safety findings to build vulnerability and condition inputs for industrial building failure scenarios in a supply-chain-critical manufacturing cluster. Related catalogue records include the Kutupalong camp fire evacuation case study and the supplier disruptions survey.
